name: Static-FineBench
notes: The repository holds desktop, web and mobile screenshots with Pascal VOC-style XML annotations and per-category JSON annotation folders, with Chinese copies, and has no dataset card. The FineState-Bench GitHub repository holds the desktop, web and mobile evaluation scripts with Loc SR, Int SR, SA-Locate SR and SA-Interact SR metrics and declares the MIT License.
summary: Data for FineState-Bench, a fine-grained GUI state-control benchmark: desktop, web and mobile screenshots with XML and JSON annotations of locate and interact instructions and separate localization and interaction boxes.
